brief:
At least five people, including three children, died when heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, Wafa news reported Sunday. The collapse occurred as the territory experienced severe weather.

Heavy rainfall destabilized the sandbank, burying those nearby. The incident adds to Gaza's exposure to environmental hazards, compounded by damage to infrastructure from the ongoing conflict.
dek: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains At least five people have been killed, including three children, after heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah, Wafa news reported on Sunday.
title: Sandbank collapse in Gaza kills five amid heavy rains
